canonical.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Les Morainières

parent.title: Weekend in Jongieux around a Saturday dinner at Les Morainières

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Les Morainières
siblings.summary: Four Jongieux B&Bs sit 1.4–1.6 km on foot from the now-3-star Les Morainières; the chef's own guest house is 4.6 km away with a shuttle, not a walk.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Les Morainières
siblings.summary: What to actually do around Jongieux — wine cellars, Lac du Bourget cruises, Aix-les-Bains spa, hikes from a vineyard loop to Mont Granier, the petite Venise at Chanaz, and a half-day in Chambéry — all within 30 km of the restaurant.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Les Morainières
siblings.summary: The 30 km bubble around Les Morainières is a tech-conference desert — one university cybersecurity lecture and a closed solar-R&D workshop in April 2026 are the only fixtures; everything else is small Chambéry meetups.

sources.title: Les Morainières — MICHELIN Guide
sources.claim: Les Morainières is a Michelin-starred restaurant in Jongieux, Savoie.

sources.title: Les Morainières — situation et accès
sources.claim: 1400 route de Marestel, 73170 Jongieux, on the Marestel hillside above the Rhône.

sources.title: La Maison des Morainières — chambres
sources.claim: Chef's 6-room guesthouse with herb-named rooms, heated outdoor pool, free shuttle to and from the restaurant.

sources.title: La Maison des Morainières — Aix-les-Bains tourist office
sources.claim: 68 route du Grand Bois, Saint-Pierre-de-Curtille; €250–320 per double.

sources.title: Château de La Mar
sources.claim: Restored 17th-c château + 6-ha Marestel vineyard producing 4 white and 2 red HV3 cuvées; spa, pool, La Table 1625.

sources.title: Château de La Mar — Booking
sources.claim: 5 rooms incl. 4 suites; doubles €220–300 with breakfast.

sources.title: Château de La Mar — TripAdvisor
sources.claim: Reviewers single out the breakfast and the in-room jetted tub.

sources.title: Domaine Carrel & Senger
sources.claim: Independent Marestel wine estate with 4 four-seasons-themed guest rooms.

sources.title: Carrel & Senger — Gîtes de France Savoie
sources.claim: 4 AC rooms above the chai, 180×200 beds, 3387 route des Vignobles, 73170 Jongieux.

sources.title: Les Chambres du Cru — Edmond Jacquin & Fils
sources.claim: 3 rooms named Pinot, Mondeuse and Gamay at 390 m on the GR9 / Compostela path; tasting on request, EV charging.

sources.title: Le Doux Nid
sources.claim: 18th-c former coaching inn at 501 route du canal, Chanaz; themed rooms, Le Relais Gourmand restaurant and boat rental.

sources.title: Chanaz — hébergements
sources.claim: Nine rooms across two historic canal-front properties; waterside breakfast patio.

sources.title: Logis Hôtel du Fer à Cheval
sources.claim: 12-room 2-star logis in medieval Yenne with a Savoyard restaurant.

sources.title: Fer à Cheval — Cybevasion
sources.claim: Open 1 April–30 October only; closed in winter.

sources.title: Château Brachet
sources.claim: 19th-c mansion of Doctor Brachet, eco-renovated 2021; 15 rooms, La Table du Château, 18 m outdoor pool, 6-ha park.

sources.title: Aix-les-Bains → Jongieux distance
sources.claim: Aix-les-Bains to Jongieux by road is ~24 km.
